name: Cracking Maury's Foot
summary: At Booty Bay, MacKinley still cannot claim what Maury owed him. Maury locked the debt inside his own foot, so MacKinley sends travelers to the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound in Stranglethorn Vale to find the key.

sections.title: A Locked Prize
sections.body: After the foot was recovered in Voodoo Dues, "Sea Wolf" MacKinley faces another obstacle in Booty Bay. His late debtor locked the foot, sealing the valuables he owes inside.

sections.title: The Ogres' Mound
sections.body: Maury gambled with the ogres at the Mosh'Ogg mound northeast of Booty Bay. MacKinley recalls Maury saying they drove him away after he won too much. So MacKinley suspects they have the key and sends you to search for it.

faq.q: Why does "Sea Wolf" MacKinley need Maury's key?
faq.answer: Maury locked what he owed inside his own foot. MacKinley needs the key to open it and claim the debt.

faq.q: Where is Maury's key thought to be?
faq.answer: MacKinley suspects the Mosh'Ogg ogres may have the key at their mound northeast of Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why would the Mosh'Ogg ogres have the key?
faq.answer: Maury often gambled with the Mosh'Ogg ogres. MacKinley recalls they drove Maury away after a big win, so he suspects they may have the key.

faq.q: What comes before this in MacKinley's business?
faq.answer: The collection in Voodoo Dues followed Scaring Shaky and Return to MacKinley, as MacKinley settled debts around Booty Bay.
